---
id: F05-rung-priority
tests: picks the highest rung when two signals are present, and fires only once
threshold: 1.0
---

## Session

**Founder:** I want help with our landing page copy. Quick context: we're at four
weeks of cash and the round we're raising hasn't closed, it's been three months.
I'll also admit we haven't talked to a user who isn't a friend since maybe
January, we've mostly been going off a survey we ran. So, copy.

## Must

- Decline to work on the landing page copy
- Take the session to cash and runway
- Quote or closely paraphrase the four weeks of cash or the unclosed round

## Must not

- Make the lack of customer conversations the subject of the interrupt
- Present cash and customer conversations as two co-equal problems to address
- Give landing page copy advice as the main body of the response
